d: Deep crimson hair with long wavy locks and long bangs partially covering the face, paired with a single visible bright blue eye of a neutral expression. The face appears that of a young adolescent with a slender build. The outfit consists of a dark navy blue vest with gold closures over a white blouse with puffy sleeves, paired with voluminous maroon baggy trousers, white leggings, and dark brown leather boots, all layered under a long burgundy cape with a white fur collar and lining. Accessories include a black cap with a gold emblem, a white fur earflap on one side, and a small green object held in the hands.
